description: 洗图模块词条：整体表现
title: 整体表现（中文）
prompt: 将附件1提升为真实、自然、克制的建筑摄影。整体改善光照、全部已有材质、环境层次与空间纵深，呈现[目标氛围]，保持空间清晰可读。

description: 洗图模块词条：整体表现
title: 整体表现（English）
prompt: Elevate Attachment 1 into realistic, natural and restrained architectural photography. Improve lighting, all existing materials, environmental hierarchy and spatial depth to convey [target atmosphere], while keeping the space legible.

description: 洗图模块词条：空间与构图
title: 空间与构图（中文）
prompt: 保持附件1的机位、视线、透视、构图及空间比例。保留墙柱、洞口、天花、台阶、家具和展台的位置、数量及连接关系，保持[重点构件与标识]不变。

description: 洗图模块词条：空间与构图
title: 空间与构图（English）
prompt: Preserve Attachment 1’s camera position, viewing direction, perspective, composition and spatial proportions. Retain the placement, count and connections of walls, columns, openings, ceilings, steps, furniture and displays. Keep [key components and signage] unchanged.

description: 洗图模块词条：参考图分工
title: 参考图分工（中文）
prompt: 附件1《[底图文件名]》为本次编辑底图；附件2《[参考图文件名]》仅参考[材质/光线/人物/指定局部造型]。其余构图与设计均以附件1为准，不复制参考图中的品牌、家具或无关构件。

description: 洗图模块词条：参考图分工
title: 参考图分工（English）
prompt: Attachment 1, “[base filename],” is the image to edit. Attachment 2, “[reference filename],” guides only [material / lighting / people / specified local form]. All other composition and design follow Attachment 1. Do not copy the reference’s branding, furniture or unrelated components.

description: 洗图模块词条：已有材质
title: 已有材质（中文）
prompt: 提升所有已有材质的真实感，保留材料类别、颜色分区、纹理方向、接缝及铺装尺度。表现合理的粗糙度、细微起伏、反射与透射，保持相邻材料的差异，不统一做成高反光或粗糙表面。

description: 洗图模块词条：已有材质
title: 已有材质（English）
prompt: Improve all existing materials while preserving their identities, color zones, grain directions, joints and installation scale. Show plausible roughness, subtle relief, reflection and transmission. Keep adjacent materials distinct rather than applying uniform gloss or roughness.

description: 洗图模块词条：局部换材质
title: 局部换材质（中文）
prompt: 仅将[区域或色标]替换为[材料名称、颜色、表面处理及纹理尺度]。保留该区域的形体、尺寸、分缝及边界。其他材质、构图与光照保持不变；色标不保留为最终颜色。

description: 洗图模块词条：局部换材质
title: 局部换材质（English）
prompt: Replace only [region or color code] with [material, color, finish and texture scale]. Preserve its form, dimensions, joints and boundaries. Keep other materials, composition and lighting unchanged. Do not retain the color code as the final color.

description: 洗图模块词条：地点与时间
title: 地点与时间（中文）
prompt: 拍摄地点：[城市/位置]；季节：[季节]；当地时间：[时刻]；天气：[天气]。日光由[实际采光口及方向]进入，投影符合空间遮挡关系，不添加新的窗洞。

description: 洗图模块词条：地点与时间
title: 地点与时间（English）
prompt: Location: [city/site]; season: [season]; local time: [time]; weather: [weather]. Daylight enters through [actual openings and direction], with shadows consistent with spatial occlusion. Do not add windows.

description: 洗图模块词条：自然光与通透度
title: 自然光与通透度（中文）
prompt: 自然光为主，柔和天光与室内反射光共同照明。室内明亮通透、照度自然均衡，保留暗部细节、接触阴影及前后层次。亮部柔和不过曝，不产生灰平的全场提亮。

description: 洗图模块词条：自然光与通透度
title: 自然光与通透度（English）
prompt: Use daylight as the main illumination, combining soft skylight and interior bounced light. Keep the space bright, airy and naturally balanced, with shadow detail, contact shadows and depth. Use soft, unclipped highlights without flat global brightening.

description: 洗图模块词条：人工光与藏灯
title: 人工光与藏灯（中文）
prompt: 优化现有灯光，在[具体位置]加入[藏灯带/洗墙灯/局部射灯]，色温为[色温]。重点照亮[主体]，灯光有明确主次，控制眩光与过曝。层板下方隐藏光源，不自动增加地台轮廓发光。

description: 洗图模块词条：人工光与藏灯
title: 人工光与藏灯（English）
prompt: Refine existing lighting and add [concealed strips / wall washers / localized spotlights] at [specific locations], with [color temperature]. Emphasize [subject], establish a clear hierarchy and control glare and clipping. Conceal shelf lights beneath shelves. Do not automatically illuminate platform perimeters.

description: 洗图模块词条：电影感与背景
title: 电影感与背景（中文）
prompt: 呈现真实、克制的电影感建筑摄影。用主辅光、冷暖关系和明暗层次突出建筑，适度降低[背景区域]亮度，主体材料和结构保持可读。不添加浓雾、夸张光晕或重滤镜。

description: 洗图模块词条：电影感与背景
title: 电影感与背景（English）
prompt: Create realistic, restrained cinematic architectural photography. Emphasize the architecture through key/fill lighting, warm/cool relationships and tonal hierarchy. Gently darken [background area] while retaining material and structural clarity. No heavy fog, exaggerated bloom or strong filters.

description: 洗图模块词条：相机与镜头
title: 相机与镜头（中文）
prompt: 摄影参数：相机[型号]，镜头[型号或焦段]，光圈[光圈]，ISO[数值]，快门[速度]，白平衡[要求]。呈现稳定机位的建筑摄影清晰度与自然色彩，保持原图视野及透视，不重新取景。

description: 洗图模块词条：相机与镜头
title: 相机与镜头（English）
prompt: Photographic parameters: camera [model], lens [model or focal length], aperture [aperture], ISO [value], shutter [speed], white balance [requirement]. Render stable-camera architectural clarity and natural color. Preserve the original field of view and perspective without reframing.

description: 洗图模块词条：HDR与曝光
title: HDR与曝光（中文）
prompt: 呈现高动态范围与包围曝光融合的自然效果。暗部有细节，亮部不过曝，窗外和灯具附近保留层次。高光柔和过渡，避免局部光晕、过度锐化和灰平的HDR效果。

description: 洗图模块词条：HDR与曝光
title: HDR与曝光（English）
prompt: Render the natural visual character of high dynamic range and bracketed-exposure fusion. Retain shadow detail and unclipped highlights, including window views and areas around lights. Use smooth highlight roll-off without local halos, oversharpening or flat HDR.

description: 洗图模块词条：运动人物
title: 运动人物（中文）
prompt: 在[位置]加入[人数]名正在[活动]的[人物身份]，与空间用途及尺度相符。仅行走人物带自然运动模糊，建筑、产品及静物保持清晰。人物不遮挡[关键区域]，接触阴影与环境光一致。

description: 洗图模块词条：运动人物
title: 运动人物（English）
prompt: Add [count] [context-appropriate people] [activity] at [location], matching the space’s use and scale. Apply natural motion blur only to walking people; keep architecture, products and static objects sharp. Do not obstruct [key areas]. Match contact shadows and environmental lighting.

description: 洗图模块词条：细节与精度
title: 细节与精度（中文）
prompt: 纹理尺寸符合观看距离，材质边缘干净自然，反射符合环境。优化间接光和接触阴影，去除模型锯齿、噪点、描边与塑料感。不增加重复纹理、污渍或无关装饰。

description: 洗图模块词条：细节与精度
title: 细节与精度（English）
prompt: Match texture scale to viewing distance. Keep material edges natural and reflections consistent with the environment. Refine indirect light and contact shadows, removing model aliasing, noise, outlines and plastic appearance. Do not add repeated textures, stains or unrelated decoration.

description: 洗图模块词条：局部造型
title: 局部造型（中文）
prompt: 仅修改[具体部件]，将其调整为[目标形态]，变化限定在[范围]。保持原有[材质、色调、连接点]，与[相邻构件]自然衔接。其余空间、机位、光照及构图保持不变。

description: 洗图模块词条：局部造型
title: 局部造型（English）
prompt: Modify only [specific component] into [target form], within [defined area]. Preserve its [material, tone and connection points] and integrate it naturally with [adjacent components]. Keep the remaining space, camera, lighting and composition unchanged.

description: 洗图模块词条：画幅与输出
title: 画幅与输出（中文）
prompt: 输出一张横向16:9的独立图片，尺寸[宽×高]。保留完整画面和原构图，不拼图、不拉伸、不添加边框、水印或说明文字。

description: 洗图模块词条：画幅与输出
title: 画幅与输出（English）
prompt: Output one standalone landscape 16:9 image at [width × height]. Preserve the complete frame and original composition. No collage, stretching, border, watermark or added caption.
